domains.name: Understanding The Roles and Responsibilities of an Apprentice in the Literary Arts Production:
Different Literary Productions in the Philippine Context

standards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of literary arts production processes, literary genres, professional practices, and ethical standards through apprenticeship experiences within the publishing and print media industry.

The learners demonstrate proficiency in literary arts production and analysis through apprenticeship engagement and creative documentation, reflecting artistic, cultural, and ethical practices in literary arts. 1

contentStandards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of literary arts production processes, literary genres, professional practices, and ethical standards through apprenticeship experiences within the publishing and print media industry.

performanceStandards.text: The learners demonstrate proficiency in literary arts production and analysis through apprenticeship engagement and creative documentation, reflecting artistic, cultural, and ethical practices in literary arts. 1

competencies.text: discuss the interdisciplinary roles and responsibilities of an apprentice in the literary arts production;
discuss the different stages of literary arts production;
describe existing and emerging literary industries that contribute to the growth of the literary industry in the Philippines; and
produce a literary analysis using the literary processes in writing based on understanding of literary genres, elements, and techniques;
demonstrate proficiency, professionalism, cultural, and ethical practices during internship or apprenticeship; and
synthesize the internship or apprenticeship experience through creative documentation.
